CheckInstanceDatasource.title: Check the connectivity of a data source
CheckInstanceDatasource.summary: Tests connectivity to a data source.

CheckModelFeatureFGFeature.title: Check whether the FG configuration of model features is correct
CheckModelFeatureFGFeature.summary: Verify that the FG configuration is correct and meets all rules.

CreateDatasource.title: Create a data source
CreateDatasource.summary: Registers a datasource in a FeatureStore instance. A datasource provides offline or online storage for a project.

CreateFeatureEntity.title: Create a feature entity
CreateFeatureEntity.summary: Creates a feature entity. A feature entity defines a join key that links multiple feature views to it, enabling feature joining.

CreateFeatureView.title: Create a feature view
CreateFeatureView.summary: Creates a feature view. Three types of feature views are supported: batch, stream, and behavior sequence. A feature view defines the feature structure through fields and is associated with a feature entity.

CreateInstance.title: Create Instance
CreateInstance.summary: Creates a FeatureStore instance. This operation is idempotent. If an instance is already running or initializing in the same account, this operation returns the existing instance ID.

CreateLLMConfig.title: Create LLM Configuration Information
CreateLLMConfig.summary: Creates an LLM configuration that contains the call parameters and API key for an embedding model. During creation, the service validates the ApiKey and Model. For a DashScope model, the EmbeddingDimension must match one of the fixed, valid dimensions supported by the model.

CreateLabelTable.title: Create label table
CreateLabelTable.summary: Creates a label table. A label table defines the schema for label data referenced by model features.

CreateModelFeature.title: Create a model feature
CreateModelFeature.summary: Creates a model feature. A model feature associates a label table with a set of feature view fields to generate the training dataset table required for model training and to specify the feature set used for model inference.

CreateProject.title: Create Project
CreateProject.summary: Creates a FeatureStore project. A project is a container for feature entities, feature views, and model features.

CreateServiceIdentityRole.title: Create Service Account Role
CreateServiceIdentityRole.summary: Creates a service-linked role that authorizes the FeatureStore service to access other cloud resources of the user. Returns a conflict error if the role already exists.

DeleteDatasource.title: Delete data source
DeleteDatasource.summary: Deletes a datasource from a FeatureStore instance.

DeleteFeatureView.title: Delete a feature view
DeleteFeatureView.summary: Deletes a feature view. A feature view cannot be deleted if it is referenced by a model feature. To delete the feature view, you must first delete the associated model feature.

DeleteLLMConfig.title: Delete LLM Configuration Information
DeleteLLMConfig.summary: Deletes an LLM call configuration. You cannot delete a configuration referenced by a feature view. You must first delete the associated feature view.

DeleteLabelTable.title: Delete the label table
DeleteLabelTable.summary: Deletes a label table. You cannot delete a label table that is referenced by a model feature. Delete the associated model feature first.

DeleteModelFeature.title: Delete model feature
DeleteModelFeature.summary: Deletes a model feature and its associated training set table.

ExportModelFeatureTrainingSetTable.title: Export the train set table of a model feature
ExportModelFeatureTrainingSetTable.summary: Export a training set table for model features. Create an export task by configuring the Label table input, the data source partition for each feature view, and the training set output partition.

GetDatasource.title: Retrieve data source details
GetDatasource.summary: Gets the detailed information about a data source, including its type, connection information, and configuration.

GetDatasourceTable.title: Obtain the details of a specified table under a data source
GetDatasourceTable.summary: Gets the field information for a specified table in a data source. This operation supports only MaxCompute data sources.

GetFeatureEntity.title: Obtain detailed information about a feature entity
GetFeatureEntity.summary: Retrieves the details of a feature entity.

GetFeatureView.title: Get feature view details
GetFeatureView.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a feature view, including field definitions, data source bindings, and synchronization status.

GetInstance.title: Obtain instance details
GetInstance.summary: Retrieves the details of a FeatureStore instance.

GetLLMConfig.title: Retrieve LLM Configuration Information
GetLLMConfig.summary: Retrieves the details of an LLM call configuration.

GetLabelTable.title: Get label table details
GetLabelTable.summary: Retrieves the details of a label table, including its field definitions and related models.

GetModelFeature.title: GetModelFeature
GetModelFeature.summary: Gets detailed information about a model feature, including the selected feature list, lineage relations, and training set export script.

GetModelFeatureFGFeature.title: Obtain the FG feature configuration information of a model feature.
GetModelFeatureFGFeature.summary: Retrieves the Feature Generation (FG) feature configuration of a model feature.

GetModelFeatureFGInfo.title: Obtain the configuration information of the fg.json file for a model feature
GetModelFeatureFGInfo.summary: Retrieves the fg.json file configuration for a model feature.

GetProject.title: Get Project Details
GetProject.summary: Gets the details of a project, including its data source bindings and resource counts.

GetProjectFeatureEntity.title: Obtain the details of a specified feature entity under a project
GetProjectFeatureEntity.summary: Retrieve details of a feature entity in a project by name.

GetServiceIdentityRole.title: Get service account role
GetServiceIdentityRole.summary: Queries the details of a service-linked role and verifies whether the role exists and is available.

GetTask.title: Obtain job details
GetTask.summary: Gets the details of an asynchronous task.

ListDatasourceFeatureViews.title: Obtain information of all feature views under a data source
ListDatasourceFeatureViews.summary: Retrieve all feature view information from the data source.

ListDatasourceTables.title: Retrieve the list of data tables under a data source
ListDatasourceTables.summary: Lists the tables in a datasource. This operation supports only MaxCompute datasources.

ListDatasources.title: Retrieve the data source list
ListDatasources.summary: Lists the data sources in a FeatureStore instance. You can filter the results by workspace, type, and name.

ListFeatureEntities.title: Retrieve the list of feature entities
ListFeatureEntities.summary: Lists the feature entities in a FeatureStore instance. You can filter the results by project, name, owner, and parent feature entity.

ListFeatureViewFieldRelationships.title: Get Feature Field Lineage
ListFeatureViewFieldRelationships.summary: Retrieves the relationships for a specific field in a feature view, returning a list of models that reference the field and the names of the associated online and offline tables.

ListFeatureViewOnlineFeatures.title: Retrieve online feature data under a feature view
ListFeatureViewOnlineFeatures.summary: Retrieves online features from a feature view based on one or more join IDs. For each join ID provided, the operation returns the corresponding feature fields as key-value pairs.

ListFeatureViewRelationships.title: Retrieve feature view lineage
ListFeatureViewRelationships.summary: Lists the relationships for a feature view, including the models that reference it.

ListFeatureViews.title: List feature views
ListFeatureViews.summary: Lists feature views, filterable by project, name, type, tag, and feature name.

ListInstances.title: Retrieve the instance list
ListInstances.summary: Lists FeatureStore instances in the current account. You can filter the instances by status.

ListLabelTables.title: Retrieve the list of label tables
ListLabelTables.summary: Lists label tables, filterable by project, name, owner, and ID.

ListModelFeatureAvailableFeatures.title: Obtain all available features under the model feature when registering FG features.
ListModelFeatureAvailableFeatures.summary: Lists the available features for a model feature when you register a feature group (FG).

ListModelFeatures.title: List model features
ListModelFeatures.summary: Lists model features, with sorting, pagination, and filtering by project, name, creator, and ID.

ListProjectFeatureViews.title: Obtain feature views and feature lists
ListProjectFeatureViews.summary: Lists all feature views and their available features in a project. Use this operation to select feature views and features for the CreateModelFeature and UpdateModelFeature operations.

ListProjectFeatures.title: Retrieve all feature information under a project
ListProjectFeatures.summary: Lists all features in a project. This operation supports filtering by name, alias, and feature view, as well as sorting and pagination. The response includes the data type, parent feature view, and the number of model features that reference each feature.

ListProjects.title: List Projects
ListProjects.summary: Lists projects in a Feature Store instance, filterable by name, workspace, and owner.

ListTaskLogs.title: Retrieve task logs
ListTaskLogs.summary: Lists the execution logs of an asynchronous task. This operation supports pagination.

ListTasks.title: Retrieve Job List
ListTasks.summary: Lists asynchronous tasks for an instance, supporting pagination and filtering by project, object type, and status.

PublishFeatureViewTable.title: Publish table data under a feature view
PublishFeatureViewTable.summary: Creates a data synchronization task to synchronize data from a feature view's offline table to its online store.

StopTask.title: Stop a job
StopTask.summary: Stops an asynchronous task. You can only stop tasks in the Initializing or Running state.

UpdateDatasource.title: Update Data Source
UpdateDatasource.summary: Updates information for a data source. Its type and workspace cannot be changed.

UpdateLLMConfig.title: Update LLM Configuration Information
UpdateLLMConfig.summary: Updates the large language model (LLM) call configuration. If you do not specify the `ApiKey` parameter, the existing key is retained. After the update, the system revalidates the model's availability and its parameters.

UpdateLabelTable.title: Update label table
UpdateLabelTable.summary: Updates the attributes of fields in a label table. You can modify the attributes of existing fields, but you cannot add or delete fields, or change field names and types.

UpdateModelFeature.title: Update model feature
UpdateModelFeature.summary: Updates the information of a model feature, including the associated label table, selected feature fields, and conflict priority policy. The update performs a full replacement. The specified Features overwrite the existing values.

UpdateModelFeatureFGFeature.title: Update the FG feature configuration information of a model feature
UpdateModelFeatureFGFeature.summary: Update the FG feature configuration for a model feature.

UpdateProject.title: Update project information
UpdateProject.summary: Updates the description of a project.

WriteFeatureViewTable.title: Write a table to the specified feature view.
WriteFeatureViewTable.summary: Imports data from a URL to the offline table of a feature view. This is an asynchronous operation.
